kind.question: What do you need?
kind.REPAIRBody: Something is damaged or worn: a seam, a zip, a panel, a protector.
kind.ALTERATIONBody: A change of fit or of a detail, for example longer sleeves.

common.problemHint: Where it is on the garment and how it happened.
common.workWantedHint: For example 'add 2 cm to the sleeves'.
common.noPayment: No payment details here: we send you an estimate first, and we start only once you accept it.

next.SEND_GARMENT: Send us the garment with a transport document (DDT); we look at it as soon as it arrives.
next.WE_ESTIMATE: We look at the garment and send you an estimate.
next.ANSWER_ESTIMATE: Read the estimate and accept or decline it.
next.WE_DECIDE: You declined the estimate: we write to you with a new one or send the garment back.
next.WE_CHECK: We check the repaired garment before it goes back.
next.ON_ITS_WAY: The garment is on its way back to you.
next.DONE: The garment went back to you.

check.item: Pick the garment to repair, or 'Another garment'.
check.serial: Type the serial on the garment's label (or scan it).
check.problem: Say what is wrong with the garment.

refusal.serial: This serial cannot be used: check the label.
refusal.open: This garment is with us for a repair already
refusal.openBody: Follow that repair instead, or write to us if it is another garment.

type.title: Repair or alteration
type.body: A repair after a fall or wear, or a change of fit ('add 2 cm to the sleeve').
type.later: For a remake or a safety incident, write to {sender} for now.

item.otherBody: Not in this delivery: type the serial on its label.
item.serialNeeded: Needed for another garment: it is on the label inside.

done.title: Repair request {number} sent
done.next: Send us the garment with a transport document (DDT). We look at it and send you an estimate before any work.

repairs.title_one: Your repair request by this link
repairs.title_other: Your {count} repair requests by this link
repairs.hint: Where they stand. The estimate is answered in your portal, or tell us by phone or mail.

start.typeBody: A repair after a fall or wear, or a change of fit. You send the garment; we send an estimate first.
start.garmentHint: One of what we delivered, or another garment by the serial on its label.
start.photosAfter: Add at least 2 photos of the damage on the request's page once it is sent.
start.sentPhotos: Add photos of the damage on the request's page: they help us estimate it.
start.sentNext: Send us the garment with a transport document (DDT). We send an estimate before any work.

list.title: Your repairs
list.hint: Repairs and alterations you asked for, newest first.
list.failed: Your repairs could not be read.

notice.accepted: You accepted the estimate of {number}: we start the work.
notice.declined: You declined the estimate of {number}: we write to you.

status.sendToHint: Put the number {number} on the transport document (DDT) that travels with it.

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.none: No estimate yet: we send one once we have looked at the garment.
estimate.noneClosed: No estimate was made for this repair.
estimate.noPrices: Your access does not show prices: the parts and the work are listed without them.
estimate.ask: We start the work only once you accept the estimate.

request.photosHint: At least {count} photos help us estimate the repair.
request.photosHintAlteration: Photos of the fit help, but are not needed.

held.offline: No connection: try again once you are back online.

photos.PREVIEW: A preview reads the portal; it never acts for the customer.
photos.NO_REQUEST: Your access lets you follow your repairs, not change them.
photos.NO_UPLOAD: Your access does not let you send files: ask your admin.
photos.STAGE: The work has started: photos are added before it.
photos.FULL: This repair holds {max} of your photos already: write to us.

answer.NOT_ASKED: No estimate waits for your answer.
answer.PREVIEW: A preview reads the portal; it never acts for the customer.
answer.NO_REQUEST: Your access lets you follow your repairs, not answer an estimate: ask your admin.
answer.NO_PRICES: Your access does not show prices: someone who sees them answers the estimate.
answer.EXPIRED: The estimate's last day has passed: ask us for a new one.

accept.title: Accept estimate {revision}?
accept.what: You accept the estimate of repair {number}.
accept.work: We start the work and tell you when it goes back.

decline.title: Decline estimate {revision}?
decline.what: We will write to you with a new estimate, or send the garment back as it is.
decline.reasonHint: Your words help us make a better offer.

problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
problem.forbidden: Your access does not let you do this.
problem.missing: This repair is no longer yours or no longer exists.
problem.changed: The repair changed meanwhile: we read it again. Check it and try again.
problem.invalid: This could not be sent as it is.
problem.tooMany: Too many tries: wait a minute and try again.
problem.photoType: A photo: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
problem.photoSize: A photo of at most 15 MB.
